title: Sparse Recovery via $\ell_1^2-η\ell_2^2$ Minimization
summary: The weighted difference of squared norms (WDSN) penalty $\ell_1^2-η\ell_2^2$ with $0\leq η\leq 1$ has attracted considerable attention due to its strong sparsity-promoting ability and favorable reconstruction performance in compressed sensing and inverse problems. However, exact recovery guarantees and restricted isometry property (RIP) analysis for WDSN minimization have not yet been established. In this paper, we address this gap.
